system_prompt:
You are taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in the eighth grade. Answer each question as well as you can.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
[Image: A right-angle triangle. Segments PQ and RQ form a right angle and their lengths are 3 and 4 centimeters respectfully. Segment PR forms the hypotenuse and is 5 centimeters.]

Which of these is the reason that triangle PQR is a right angle triangle?

Figure, described in words:
A right triangle PQR with vertices shown as solid black dots. Vertex Q forms a right angle between vertical side PQ and horizontal side QR. Side PQ is on the left and has a length of 3 cm indicated by a double-headed vertical arrow. Side QR is along the bottom and has a length of 4 cm indicated by a double-headed horizontal arrow. The hypotenuse PR connects P at the top left to R at the bottom right, with a length of 5 cm indicated by a double-headed diagonal arrow.

A. 3^2 + 4^2 = 5^2
B. 5 < 3 + 4
C. 3 + 4 = 12 − 5
D. 3 > 5 − 4

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
answer.title: Answer
